EQUATION:
odeType = stiff

; Depot compartment (oral absorption)
depot(target = Ad, Tlag = Tlag, p = F)
ddt_Ad = -ka * Ad

; Central compartment
ddt_Ac = ka * Ad - k*Ac - k12*Ac + k21*Ap2 - k13*Ac + k31*Ap3

; Peripheral compartment 1
ddt_Ap2 = k12*Ac - k21*Ap2

; Peripheral compartment 2
ddt_Ap3 = k13*Ac - k31*Ap3

; Concentration in central compartment
Cc = Ac/V
